Privacy

Short version: we only store what's needed to send you the newsletter.

Get the 26D briefing before your test pod updates

Free 26D checklist PDF when you subscribe. One plain-English email per Oracle quarterly update, linked to Oracle's docs.

Free. 4 emails a year plus short opt-in alerts. Unsubscribe anytime. Privacy

What we store when you subscribe

  • Your email address
  • The module area you picked (e.g. Supply Chain or HCM)
  • When you signed up
  • A one-way hash of your IP address, kept only to limit spam signups (we never store the IP address itself)

How we use it

Only to send the Fusion Updates newsletter (about one email per Oracle quarterly update, plus occasional short alerts about opt-in expirations). We don't sell or share your data, and we don't add you to other lists.

Where it's kept

Subscriber data is stored with Supabase (EU region, Frankfurt), and newsletters are sent with Resend (EU region). Both act as processors for us.

Unsubscribe and deletion

Every email has a one-click unsubscribe link. To have your data deleted, or for any question, write to hello@fusionupdates.com.

Analytics

This site uses no tracking cookies, and newsletter open and click tracking is turned off.

Fusion Updates is an independent publication. Questions about your data: hello@fusionupdates.com. Last updated: October 2026.
